perks.summary: +10% handling while wielding a two-handed sword, axe or mace; under RBM it also reduces the posture the troop loses when blocking or parrying with that weapon.
perks.conditions: Wielding a TwoHanded-skill melee weapon (two-handed sword/axe/mace; not two-handed polearms, which are Polearm skill). The captain half (+30 two-handed skill to infantry in the formation) never applies to a troop.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the agent's own CharacterObject into HandlingMultiplier; method is not patched by RBM.
Captain half (AddPerkBonusFromCaptain), needs the troop to be the formation captain.
RBM posture: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the defender's CharacterObject; divides posture lost on blocks/parries by the handling bonus (postureEnabled, rbmAi).
Auto-resolve captain check; no Mission.Current so troop perks never apply.

perks.rbm: RBMAI multiplies HandlingMultiplier by stamina (*=, perk kept). RBM posture adds its own read of the perk (block posture cost). Posture factor is cached per Stance and not refreshed if the troop-perk map changes mid-mission.

perks.summary: +30% damage to shields when a two-handed weapon hit is blocked by a shield (or lands on a shield on the back).
perks.conditions: TwoHanded-skill melee weapon; the hit is a shield block or a shield-on-back collision. Halved at sea (NavalReduced).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject when AttackBlockedWithShield || CollidedWithShieldOnBack; runs via Mission.GetAttackCollisionResults -> CalculateDamage on RBM's shield damage.

perks.rbm: RBM replaces ComputeBlowDamageOnShield (bypass #2) but still writes InflictedDamage, which CalculateDamage then amplifies, so the perk applies on top of RBM's shield damage.

perks.summary: +3% swing (attack animation) speed while wielding a two-handed sword, axe or mace.
perks.conditions: Wielding a TwoHanded-skill melee weapon; personal half is not foot-gated. Halved at sea. Captain half (+2% swing speed to infantry) needs a hero captain.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the agent's CharacterObject into SwingSpeedMultiplier.

perks.rbm: RBMAI's SetWeaponSkillEffectsOnAgent replacement runs before the perk; RBMAI stamina scaling is *=. Like vanilla, swing magnitude (RBM's CalculateBaseMeleeBlowMagnitude rewrite) uses the item's swing speed, so the perk speeds the animation but adds no damage.

perks.summary: +10% damage with two-handed axes and two-handed maces.
perks.conditions: WeaponClass TwoHandedAxe or TwoHandedMace (not two-handed swords). Halved at sea. Captain half (+2% infantry damage) needs a hero captain.
perks.rbm: CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's damage (bypass-map note 8), also in RBM's posture crush-through recalculation.

perks.summary: Two-handed swings with a knockdown-capable weapon ignore 30% of the victim's knockdown resistance, making knockdowns more likely; in practice only heavy two-handed maces qualify.
perks.conditions: Swing with a TwoHanded-skill weapon whose flags include CanKnockDown (vanilla: only the crafting pieces mace_head_24/34/37/38, i.e. two-handed maces), sweet-spot hit on a foot victim's head/torso/arms/legs. Halved at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject; called from MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.DecideWeaponKnockDown, gated by CanWeaponKnockDown; neither patched by RBM.

perks.rbm: Mission.CreateMeleeBlow's knockdown decision is not patched; RBM's postfixes only add knockdowns (passive attacks, posture, kicks). RBM's mace_head_24/34/37/38 overrides have no Flags node, so the attribute merge keeps vanilla's CanKnockDown (not verified in game).

perks.summary: Nothing for a troop: the infantry XP on two-handed kills is only handed out from the hero combat-hit event and read with Hero.GetPerkValue.

sites.why: attacker.HeroObject.GetPerkValue; the event is only fired for heroes (MapEventParty.OnTroopScoreHit, decompiled/TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem/TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.MapEvents/MapEventParty.cs:392).
PartyLeader half (AddPerkBonusForParty); RBM's GetXpFromHit rewrite re-invokes it by reflection.

perks.rbm: Was missing from the loader's hero-only list; added to TroopPerks.NoTroopEffectPerkIds (HeroOnly) after this audit, so the loader now logs it as having no effect.

perks.summary: +50% damage to horses and other mounts with two-handed swords, axes and maces.
perks.conditions: TwoHanded-skill melee weapon, the victim is a mount. Land only.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject when IsVictimAgentMount.

perks.rbm: CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's damage.

perks.summary: +40% damage to shields when a two-handed weapon hit is blocked by a shield (stacks with Wood Chopper).
perks.conditions: TwoHanded-skill melee weapon; the hit is a shield block or a shield-on-back collision. Halved at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject inside the shield-hit branch.

perks.rbm: As Wood Chopper: RBM's shield damage still passes through CalculateDamage.

perks.summary: +20% damage with two-handed swords, axes and maces while the troop is below half health.
perks.conditions: TwoHanded-skill melee weapon, attacker Health/HealthLimit < 0.5. Halved at sea. Governor half is campaign-only.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject when AttackerHitPointRate < 0.5.

perks.rbm: CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's damage.

perks.summary: +15% damage with two-handed swords, axes and maces while the troop is above 90% health.
perks.conditions: TwoHanded-skill melee weapon, attacker Health/HealthLimit > 0.9. Halved at sea. Governor half is campaign-only.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject when AttackerHitPointRate > 0.9.

perks.rbm: CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's damage.

perks.summary: Nothing for a troop: the arrow-deflection agent flag is only set for hero agents.
perks.rbm: Listed in TroopPerks.NoTroopEffectPerkIds (HeroOnly); the loader logs it as having no effect.

perks.summary: Kills and knock-outs with a two-handed sword, axe or mace cause 20% more morale loss to nearby enemies, except when killing siege defenders under RBM AI.
perks.conditions: Killing blow weapon class TwoHandedSword/Axe/Mace (not two-handed polearms). Lost when the victim is a siege defender with rbmAiEnabled (unless the keep-battle exception applies). Halved at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the killer's CharacterObject into the affected-side loss (bonuses2 is returned as affectedSideMaxMoraleLoss).

perks.rbm: Bypass #17: RBMAI's AgentMoraleInteractionLogic.ApplyMoraleEffectOnAgentIncapacitated prefix discards the morale shock when a siege defender goes down.

perks.summary: Kills and knock-outs with a two-handed sword, axe or mace give nearby allies 30% more morale, except when killing siege defenders under RBM AI.
perks.conditions: Killing blow weapon class TwoHandedSword/Axe/Mace. Lost when the victim is a siege defender with rbmAiEnabled (unless the keep-battle exception applies). Halved at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the killer's CharacterObject into the affector-side gain (bonuses is returned as affectorSideMaxMoraleGain).

perks.summary: On foot, +20% to the forward-movement speed bonus that two-handed swings and thrusts get, so attacks made while advancing hit harder.
perks.conditions: On foot, TwoHanded-skill weapon, extra linear speed > 0 (attacker moving into the blow). Halved at sea. Captain half (+2% damage and speed to infantry) needs a hero captain.

sites.why: Vanilla path skipped by RBM's CalculateBaseMeleeBlowMagnitude prefix (bypass #3).
Same, skipped when RBM handles the thrust.
RBM re-implementation, AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject, called for RBM swings and thrusts.

perks.rbm: Vanilla magnitude path replaced; RBM re-applies the perk with the same foot/2H/extra-speed conditions.

perks.summary: +5 maximum hit points in battle (only in battle; the party screen still shows the base value).
perks.conditions: Any weapon, land and sea. The PartyLeader half (+5 HP to party troops) needs a hero party leader.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the troop; read via Agent.Character setter (BaseHealthLimit = MaxHitPoints(), Agent.cs:1438) during spawn with Mission.Current set, then GetEffectiveMaxHealth builds HealthLimit on it.
Hero HP refresh on perk activation, campaign.

perks.rbm: No RBM patch touches MaxHitpoints, BaseHealthLimit or GetEffectiveMaxHealth.

perks.summary: +10% damage with two-handed swords, axes and maces.
perks.conditions: TwoHanded-skill melee weapon, mounted or on foot. Halved at sea. Captain half (+2% attack speed to infantry) needs a hero captain.
perks.rbm: CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's damage.

perks.summary: The victim's armor counts 25% lower against all of the troop's attacks, any weapon (melee, ranged, unarmed), not only two-handed.
perks.conditions: Victim armor > 0. Halved at sea. The captain half (+20% damage to destructible objects) needs a hero captain.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's CharacterObject; called by RBM's ComputeBlowDamage rewrite (DamageRework.Core.cs:205).
Same check in the War Sails copy.

perks.rbm: Bypass #1: RBM calls CalculateAdjustedArmorForBlow and uses the adjusted armor, re-applying the ratio for its rebuilt face / under-shoulder armor (DamageRework.Core.cs:198-210).

perks.summary: For each point of two-handed skill above 250: +0.2% swing and thrust speed and +0.5% damage with two-handed weapons; no shipped troop has more than 220 skill, so it does nothing unless the troop's skill is raised.
perks.conditions: The troop's raw TwoHanded skill (GetSkillValue) above 250; TwoHanded-skill melee weapon. Halved at sea.

sites.why: AddEpicPerkBonusForCharacter (primary) into SwingSpeedMultiplier, skill above MaxSkillRequiredForEpicPerkBonus (250).

perks.rbm: Neither path is touched by RBM. Vanilla troop TwoHanded skills top out at 220 (spnpccharacters.xml), RBM's unit overhaul at 200.
